skill.summary: Play classic MTV music videos from the 80s, 90s, and 2000s. Use when the user wants to watch MTV, music videos, retro TV, or says anything like 'play MTV', '...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Updated guidance to clarify that MTV Rewind focuses on 80s–2010s music videos, not just current chart hits.
- Adjusted “When NOT to Use” section to mention limited coverage for brand-new releases and strongest support for retro content.
